pr_body:
`Transformation#readFromCache` returns `UncommitedAsset`s, but never actually loads their content/ast/maps.

This happened when an asset ran through at least two pipelines and it was readded to the asset graph but there is a transformation cache entry that can be reused and
it also only happened if the second pipeline (so the first one being [‘transformer-json’] and the second the standard js one) added invalidations. this is the only case where the first pipeline result was read from cache and the second pipeline actually reruns (because the invalidations aren’t known yet)

For this reason, this bug (introduced 10 months ago) didn't really surface until invalidations were added.

Closes https://github.com/parcel-bundler/parcel/issues/5623
Closes https://github.com/parcel-bundler/parcel/issues/5656
Closes https://github.com/parcel-bundler/parcel/issues/5311

issue_context.title: Cache results in empty bundle
issue_context.body:
# 🐛 bug report

In [a project](https://github.com/steelbrain/linter-ui-default) that I am working on, sometimes the build results in an empty bundle. I have to clean .parcel-cache to fix this problem.

```js
> cross-env NODE_ENV=production parcel build --target main ./lib/index.ts

√ Built in 7.07s

dist\index.js          35 B    177ms
└── lib\index.ts    1.61 KB    3.36s
```

This happens when I edit the code and build again.

## 🎛 Configuration (.babelrc, package.json, cli command)

<!--- If describing a bug, tell us what your babel configuration looks like -->

```json
  "targets": {
    "main": {
      "context": "node",
      "includeNodeModules": {
        "atom": false,
        "electron": false,
        "react": false,
        "react-dom": false,
        "atom-package-deps": false
      },
      "outputFormat": "commonjs",
      "isLibrary": true
    }
  },
```

## 🤔 Expected Behavior
build normally
<!--- Tell us what should happen -->

## 😯 Current Behavior
The build results in an empty bundle if .parcel-cache exists

<!--- Tell us what happens instead of the expected behavior -->

<!--- If you are seeing an error, please include the full error message and stack trace -->

## 💁 Possible Solution

Remove .parcel-cache
<!--- Not obligatory, but suggest a fix/reason for the bug -->

## 🔦 Context

<!--- How has this issue affected you? What are you trying to accomplish? -->

<!--- Providing context helps us come up with a solution that is most useful in the real world -->

## 💻 Code Sample

https://github.com/steelbrain/linter-ui-default

<!-- Please provide a code repository, gist, code snippet or sample files to reproduce the issue -->

## 🌍 Your Environment

<!--- Include as many relevant details about the environment you experienced the bug in -->

| Software         | Version(s) |
| ---------------- | ---------- |
| Parcel           | Parcel 2 nightlies (this is an old bug I have seen for a long time)
| Node             | 15.5 (irrelevant) 
| npm/Yarn         | 6.14.11
| Operating System | Win 10

<!-- Love parcel? Please consider supporting our collective:
👉  https://opencollective.com/parcel/donate -->

2. npm run build
3. npm run dev 
4. npm run build

4 is empty, the other ones are correct

review_comments:
Not sure if this could actually be a `CommitedAsset`? Changes needed would be:
- `CommitedAssets#getInvalidations`
- `CommitedAsset#createChildAsset`
- `new MutableAsset(commitedAsset)` sounds problematic though.
